source.prompt: French touch filtered house song, about 3.5 minutes, 119 BPM, E-flat major. Glamorous, sunlit summer-night mood, playful and warm. Smooth, confident female lead vocal with airy stacked harmonies on the chorus. Filtered disco string section sweeping in and out, warm Rhodes electric piano chords, funky muted clean electric guitar, round fingered bass guitar, soft brass section stabs. Four-on-the-floor kick with sidechain pumping, claps on 2 and 4, offbeat open hats, tambourine, slow low-pass filter sweeps opening into each chorus. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal and Rhodes, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
